pages.html:
Alphabet shares surge after dodging antitrust breakup bullet

Shares of Alphabet rose sharply on Tuesday after a federal judge declined to order a breakup of the company, a ruling analysts said removes a major overhang.

The decision lifted other large technology stocks as investors bet that regulators would struggle to force structural remedies on the sector.
